decision_comment_id: comment_id is unique within each stripped post_url and restarts at 1 on every post. Global repetition is not sufficient evidence of a duplicate comment. No rows were removed.
decision_post_url_whitespace: 212 rows on one URL have a leading space. The original URL is retained. Joins use post_url_stripped.
decision_collection_date: Each of the 19 posts has a single collection timestamp. These values describe data collection, not source-post publication.
decision_text_normalization: comment_original keeps the file text. comment_whitespace_normalized collapses whitespace only. Case, Somali spelling, and tokens are unchanged at this stage.
